`interface WatchProperty`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.node.property` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [WatchProperty.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/node/property/WatchProperty.java)

Action that `Node.watch(...)` runs on its node each time the watched signal changes.

## Description

Pass one or more to [`Node.watch`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-method-watch): `watch(items, WatchProperty.CLEAR_CHILDREN, WatchProperty.BODY)` removes the children, then runs the body again, so the node rebuilds its subtree from the current value.
A lambda `(node, signal) -> ...` gives an action of your own.
When an action throws, JOID prints a warning and the other actions of the watch still run.

## Constant and field details

<a id="WatchProperty-constant-BODY"></a>

### BODY

`WatchProperty BODY` 

Runs the body that the node received with `body(...)` again; it does nothing on a node without body.
It does not remove the children that the previous body added: put `CLEAR_CHILDREN` before it.

<a id="WatchProperty-constant-CLEAR_CHILDREN"></a>

### CLEAR_CHILDREN

`WatchProperty CLEAR_CHILDREN` 

Removes every child of the node.
